 Jennifer Lawrence Just Ranked Her On-Screen Kisses, And No One Is Surprised By The Person She Put Dead Last
 “She knew her worst right away 😂”
 Posted on Nov 20, 2026 UTC comment 
 Facebook 
 Pinterest 
 Link 
 by Ellen Durney BuzzFeed BuzzFeed Staff I get to spend my days writing all about the pop culture stories that your group chats are talking about.
 Jennifer Lawrence has made a lot of movies, and that means she's had to kiss a lot of people in movies, too. 
 John Nacion / Getty Images
 So, during a recent appearance on Watch What Happens Live alongside her Hunger Games costar, Josh Hutcherson , Jen was asked to rank her on-screen kisses from best to worst. 
 Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen / Bravo / Via youtu.be 
 " Liam Hemsworth , Bradley Cooper , Josh Hutcherson, Chris Pratt , [Timothée] Chalamet," host Andy Cohen said, listing off the names of some of her most famous former costars — including the one sitting right next to her. 
 Kevin Mazur / Getty Images, Kevin Winter / Getty Images, CBS Photo Archive / Getty Images
 "I'll go Pratt, Chalamet..." she began, before Andy stepped in to remind her that the ranking was from best to worst, not worst to best. 
 Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen / Bravo / Via youtu.be 
 "Oh, best is Josh," she said, prompting a little celebratory fist-pump from the man himself. 
 Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen / Bravo / Via youtu.be 
 "And then Hemsworth, Cooper, Chalamet, Pratt," she concluded. 
 Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen / Bravo / Via youtu.be 
 Aside from Josh's evident glee at being ranked at the top, people are amused that Jen had no hesitation in ranking Chris — whom she starred opposite in the space romance movie Passengers (2016) — as the worst of the bunch. 
 Han Myung-Gu / Getty Images
 "She knew her worst right away 😂," read one TikTok comment with over 38,000 likes. "She said 'Pratt, Chalamet' and [Andy] immediately knew he had to remind her it’s best to worst lmao 😭," someone else joked. 
 Just Luna Things / TikTok / Via tiktok.com 
 april / Via tiktok.com 
 liloyo07 / Via tiktok.com 
 Travis Cinnamon / Via tiktok.com 
 If you've followed J.Law's career for a long time, her putting Chris last probably won't be surprising to you. On Reddit , users have brought up the fact that she previously talked about "how much guilt she felt kissing Pratt because he was married." "It was the first time she kissed a married costar," the user recalled. "It sounds like the whole experience was not good for her." 
 Albert L. Ortega / Getty Images
 For context, while filming the movie in 2015, Jennifer said during a Hollywood Reporter roundtable : "It was weird. And everything was done right — nobody did anything wrong. It's just a bizarre experience... I got really, really drunk. But then that led to more anxiety when I got home because I was like, 'What have I done?' And it was going to be my first time kissing a married man, and guilt is the worst feeling in your stomach. And I knew it was my job, but I couldn't tell my stomach that. So I called my mom, and I was like, 'Will you just tell me it's OK?' It was just very vulnerable." 
 ©Columbia Pictures/Courtesy Everett Collection
 She continued: "You don't know what's too much. You want to do it real, you want everything to be real... That was the most vulnerable I've ever been." (The movie later sparked rumors of an affair between Jennifer and Chris, although she and Anna Faris both firmly shut that down.) 
 Steve Granitz / Getty Images
 Others have suggested Jen's kiss ranking system might also factor in the context of the movies — so it's worth remembering that Chris's character in Passengers basically forces Jen's character to be alone with him in outer space. 
 ©Columbia Pictures/Courtesy Everett Collection
 "It also reflects the least to most problematic of the characters’ relationships she was playing, which makes sense for comfortability," one Reddit user theorized. "Peeta>Gale> Silver Lining’s Playbook guy>guy who kidnapped you and dragged you to outer space." 
 ©Columbia Pictures/Courtesy Everett Collection
 Honestly, sounds like a pretty smart ranking system to me. You can watch the full clip here .
